verses.he: מִזְמֹ֗ור לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי־יָג֣וּר בְּאָהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי־יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ يَارَبُّ، مَنْ يَنْزِلُ فِي مَسْكَنِكَ؟ مَنْ يَسْكُنُ فِي جَبَلِ قُدْسِكَ؟
verses.en: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall sojourn in Thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell upon Thy holy mountain?
verses.kjv: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.web: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

verses.he: הֹולֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָבֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱلسَّالِكُ بِٱلْكَمَالِ، وَٱلْعَامِلُ ٱلْحَقَّ، وَٱلْمُتَكَلِّمُ بِٱلصِّدْقِ فِي قَلْبِهِ.
verses.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh truth in his heart;
verses.kjv: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.web: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

verses.he: לֹֽא־רָגַ֨ל ׀ עַל־לְשֹׁנֹ֗ו לֹא־עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא־נָשָׂ֥א עַל־קְרֹֽבֹו׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي لَا يَشِي بِلِسَانِهِ، وَلَا يَصْنَعُ شَرًّا بِصَاحِبِهِ، وَلَا يَحْمِلُ تَعْيِيرًا عَلَى قَرِيبِهِ.
verses.en: That hath no slander upon his tongue, nor doeth evil to his fellow, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour;
verses.kjv: [He that] backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.web: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

verses.he: נִבְזֶ֤ה ׀ בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר׃
verses.ar: وَٱلرَّذِيلُ مُحْتَقَرٌ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ، وَيُكْرِمُ خَائِفِي ٱلرَّبِّ. يَحْلِفُ لِلضَّرَرِ وَلَا يُغَيِّرُ.
verses.en: In whose eyes a vile person is despised, but he honoureth them that fear the LORD; he that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;
verses.kjv: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. [He that] sweareth to [his own] hurt, and changeth not.
verses.web: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

verses.he: כַּסְפֹּ֤ו ׀ לֹא־נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל־נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה־אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמֹּ֣וט לְעֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: فِضَّتُهُ لَا يُعْطِيهَا بِٱلرِّبَا، وَلَا يَأْخُذُ ٱلرِّشْوَةَ عَلَى ٱلْبَرِيءِ. ٱلَّذِي يَصْنَعُ هَذَا لَا يَتَزَعْزَعُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.en: He that putteth not out his money on interest, nor taketh a bribe against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.kjv: [He that] putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these [things] shall never be moved.
verses.web: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
